adv2-client.rule: Two distinct objects share the name `adv2-client`: (a) the ClientModel itself (always added to the candidate set per scope-resolution.md L13-17, then filtered out at DCSC.L200 by the `NOT instanceof ClientModel` filter) and (b) a ClientScopeModel literally named `adv2-client` attached as a default scope (L660, defined L890-898) with `include.in.token.scope=true` (L894). The DCSC.L200 client-self filter is by `instanceof ClientModel`, NOT by name match — so the ClientScopeModel survives. Result: `adv2-client` appears once in the scope claim (the scope, not the client). The scope description (L891) explicitly flags this as a probe of the L200 filter.
